Settings.Name: Open Preset Picker
Settings.Tooltip: Opens a list of every Close Camera preset, built-in and custom. Click one to apply it. Custom presets go in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Larian Studios\Baldur's Gate 3\Script Extender\TrueThirdPersonCamera\Presets.
Settings.Description: Opens a list of every Close Camera preset, built-in and custom. Click one to apply it.

Settings.Name: Camera View Toggle Key
Settings.Tooltip: Click to press any key on your keyboard to set as your camera toggle key (default Numpad *).

Settings.Name: Shoulder Swap Key
Settings.Tooltip: Click to press any key on your keyboard to set as your Shoulder Swap key (default Numpad /). Press B on Xbox or Circle on PlayStation controllers to do the same.

Settings.Name: Character Switch Transition Duration
Settings.Tooltip: How many seconds it takes for the camera to move to the next character when you switch.

Settings.Name: Invert Camera Pitch
Settings.Tooltip: Inverts the up/down camera tilt for mouse and controller.

Settings.Name: Middle Mouse Look Toggle
Settings.Tooltip: Click middle mouse once to keep looking around without holding it. Click again to restore the cursor. Escape, switching to a controller, or leaving the game window releases mouse look. Keep the game's Camera Rotate binding on middle mouse.

Settings.Name: Mouse Look Sensitivity
Settings.Tooltip: Camera turning speed for the mouse. Higher is faster.

Settings.Name: Mouse Vertical Look Sensitivity
Settings.Tooltip: How fast the camera tilts up and down with the mouse.

Settings.Name: Mouse Zoom Sensitivity
Settings.Tooltip: How fast the camera zooms with the mouse wheel.

Settings.Name: Controller Look Sensitivity
Settings.Tooltip: Camera turning speed for the controller right stick. Higher is faster.

Settings.Name: Controller Vertical Look Sensitivity
Settings.Tooltip: How fast the camera tilts up and down with the controller.

Settings.Name: Controller Zoom Sensitivity
Settings.Tooltip: How fast the camera zooms with the controller.

Sections.SectionDescription: The fixed over-the-shoulder camera you switch to with the toggle button/key. Can't be manually zoomed. This is where the dynamic combat camera and all of this mod's other features apply.

Settings.Name: Normal Zoom
Settings.Tooltip: Camera zoom distance when in Close (over-the-shoulder) view mode.

Settings.Name: Normal Field of View
Settings.Tooltip: Field of view when in Close Camera view. Lower values feel more cinematic, higher values show more of the scene.

Settings.Name: Horizontal Offset
Settings.Tooltip: Left/right shoulder offset of the camera in Close view. Positive values move the camera to the right, negative to the left.

Settings.Name: Vertical Offset
Settings.Tooltip: Up/down offset of the camera in Close view while standing.

Settings.Name: Crouch Vertical Offset
Settings.Tooltip: Additional vertical offset applied while the character is crouching in Close view.

Sections.SectionDescription: Camera used while aiming or casting a spell or attack outside of combat.

Settings.Name: Cast Zoom
Settings.Tooltip: Fixed zoom distance while aiming a spell or attack outside combat, or using free look.

Sections.SectionDescription: Adds on top of the sliders above while sprinting. Does nothing at 0.

Settings.Name: Running Zoom
Settings.Tooltip: Extra zoom while running. Negative brings the camera closer instead.

Settings.Name: Running Field of View
Settings.Tooltip: Extra field of view while running. Negative narrows it instead.

Settings.Name: Running Horizontal Offset
Settings.Tooltip: Extra left/right offset while running.

Settings.Name: Running Vertical Offset
Settings.Tooltip: Extra up/down offset while running.

Sections.SectionDescription: Camera used in combat while moving, or while an attack or spell is playing out, yours or an enemy's.

Settings.Name: Combat Zoom
Settings.Tooltip: Fixed zoom distance during combat while you or an enemy is moving, attacking, or casting a spell.

Settings.Name: Combat Field of View
Settings.Tooltip: Field of view used during combat while you or an enemy is moving, attacking, or casting a spell.

Sections.SectionDescription: Camera used on your own turn while you're aiming or picking a target, such as choosing a spell, attack, or where to move.

Settings.Name: Aiming Zoom
Settings.Tooltip: Zoom while aiming/selecting a target in combat.

Settings.Name: Aiming Field of View
Settings.Tooltip: FOV while aiming/selecting a target in combat.

Sections.SectionDescription: This is the Far camera view, working almost exactly like the original Native Camera Tweaks mod. It can be manually zoomed, but the dynamic combat camera and this mod's other features only apply in Close view.

Settings.Name: Use Vanilla Camera in Far View
Settings.Tooltip: When enabled, the Far view camera behaves exactly like the vanilla game camera, in every situation.

Settings.Name: Prevent Floor Clipping
Settings.Tooltip: Keeps the camera from clipping through floors and walls. Can cause a visible snap while aiming near a wall or the ground. Turn off to avoid that, at the cost of sometimes seeing underground. Close view always avoids clipping regardless of this setting.

Settings.Name: Far Zoom
Settings.Tooltip: Camera zoom distance in Far view.

Settings.Name: Far Field of View
Settings.Tooltip: Field of view in Far view.
